description: CFTIlandslides, Italian database of historical earthquake-induced landslides is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Caterina Zei et al. Knowing the location, the extent and the characteristics of any earthquake-induced environmental phenomenon is becoming an increasingly pressing need for civil protection agencies and local administrations. In particular, earthquake-triggered landslides are known for being among the most important sources of secondary hazard, as they may cause significant losses and may delay rescue operations across large areas. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2024. Formats: CSV, JSON, XML, ZIP. The data are held in INGV and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: hundreds. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is Open Access, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
